text.name: Text
text.text: Prediction markets shows a small query (Applications / Market query): status, question, four stages (Asked, Reported Yes, Not challenged, Final) and the outcomes Yes, No and Invalid, at rest on Final. When the card scrolls into view, and whenever its tab is chosen, the website plays the stages in (0, 0.6, 1.3, 2 s): the current stage is Green with a Paper label and steps back to Pewter as the next begins, the status passes through Awaiting report and Open to challenge, Yes goes from one outcome among three to outlined (reported) to Green with a check (final), and the signal then runs down to the backstop. Press Play on the frame beside the states to see it. Visitors no longer pick the answer.

text.name: Title
text.text: Tenet animations

text.name: Summary
text.text: The three diagrams loop seamlessly while any part of them is on screen, from one shared choreography (website tenet-choreography.ts and these keyframes). Every element runs its own 12 s track that opens and closes on the diagram drawn on Homepage, so that frame is also the reduced-motion, print and no-JavaScript state. This 24 s timeline shows the start (the later Permissionless crossers leave and come back on their turn instead of waiting on the edge) and one steady cycle.

text.name: Label
text.text: DETAILS

text.name: Text
text.text: Permissionless: four newcomers start on the open edge, 3 s apart, and never stop on it. Each finishes crossing (0–0.7 s), lights Green as it passes the edge (0.35–0.6 s), stays on as a Paper member (2.4–4 s), settles to Mist by 5.6 s, leaves back across the edge (6.4–7.3 s) and slides back in at the speed it carries into its seat (its last 0.29–0.43 s). While the later three wait for their first turn they leave and come back instead of standing on the edge. Seated members brighten softly in turn, one every 0.9 s, so two or three squares are lit at once.

text.name: Text
text.text: Decentralized: a relay tours the mesh without ever turning back, 8→9→10→5→1→2→6→10→11→7→3→6→10→9→4→0→1→5→4→8, through every square and along all 16 links, at constant speed with a 140 ms handoff at each square and 900 ms at home. Each link it crosses and each square it visits stays lit and fades over 0.9 s, so the path trails behind it.

text.name: Text
text.text: Trustless: each lane fires like a neuron on its own rhythm (lane 1 at 0, 2.9, 6.1 and 9 s; lane 2 at 1.1, 4.7 and 9.7 s; lane 3 at 2.2, 5.6 and 8.4 s). The sender flashes Paper and pops to 118%, a Paper signal with two fainter followers crosses the empty middle in 1.2 s as the solid segments light, and the receiver fires Green for 0.4 s and pops to 116%. The middle never lights, and every receiver rests Mist.

text.name: Text
text.text: Pulse (owner pick, 6 Oct 2026): every square that lights up pops to 116% (up in 0.14 s, back by 0.42 s) and sends out a 1 px outline of itself that grows to 175% as it fades from 85% (0.7 s). Paper for members brightening and senders flashing, Green for crossers, relay landings and receivers. Flat, no glow.

text.name: Text
text.text: Answer ribbon: unchanged; sweeps in once when 60% of the band is visible.

text.name: Label
text.text: FOR THE BUILD

text.name: Text
text.text: Trigger: a scene runs whenever any part of it is on screen; off-screen or in a hidden tab it pauses where it is and resumes from that frame. A reload or a history visit never replays entrance scenes.

text.name: Text
text.text: Easing: reveal cubic-bezier(.22, .61, .36, 1); crossfade (.45, 0, .55, 1); newcomer overshoot (.45, 1.45, .8, 1); signals linear.

text.name: Text
text.text: SVG animates transform, not the individual translate and scale properties: in Chromium those re-layerized the diagrams every frame (about 2 s of main thread per 5 s, against 0.05 s).

text.name: Text
text.text: The crossers’ one-off lead-ins run on a wrapper element: in Chromium a loop that starts beside a second animation of the same property on its element stays on the main thread for good (about 830 ms per 5 s, against 10).
